fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/run -run 'TestBriefFiles|TestSessionDir|TestHandbackFile' shows brief.md's sections in order with the change set, its intent, every leaf with its acceptance, the decisions, the constraints, both check commands (and 'none' when neither is set) and the contract summary's last line; the same input rendering the same bytes twice; session directory names for an agent step, a builder of a leaf at attempt 2 and a checks step's check; handback.md naming the failing step and outcome with each failing gate command and its output path for a gate cause, each failed CI run and its saved log file for a CI cause, and each conflicted file for a conflict cause; failure cases: a directory that cannot be created returns an error naming its path, and a cause naming no failing step is refused. Touches: internal/run/brief.go (new), internal/run/brief_test.go (new). Must not touch internal/api or the workflow parser.
fields.statement: internal/run renders a session's context files into its directory <commondir>/rhiza/runs/<run id>/<step>[/<role or check>-<leaf>-<attempt>]/, which is kept when the run ends and lies inside no worktree: brief.md, deterministic Markdown with these sections in order: the change set (title, ID, intent), the leaves (handle, statement, acceptance each), the decisions (statement each), the constraints (statement each), the check commands (rhiza.ship.prePushCheck and rhiza.ship.localGate when set, else none) and a short contract summary ending 'Full contract: rhiza guide contract'; slice.json, the bytes it is given; and handback.md, written from a hand-back cause of any failing step: the failing step and its outcome, each failing command with the path of its kept output (a gate step's), each failed CI run with its saved log file (rhiza ship check --json findings), and each conflicted file, by a writer that run-handback calls and that nothing else in this change set triggers.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow -run TestInvokeTemplate covers invoke and handback parsing on an agent step, a leaves step's builder and verifier, and a checks step's check, critic, fixer and verifier, prompt as an alias of invoke, and rendering every placeholder; failure cases: rhiza workflow check refuses an unknown placeholder naming it, and a table setting both prompt and invoke; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/workflow-invoke shows a fake agent receiving '/myskill:conduct --prompt <path to its brief.md>' as its first prompt. Touches: internal/workflow/workflow.go, internal/workflow/check.go, internal/workflow/spec.go, internal/workflow/include.go, internal/workflow/workflow_test.go, internal/api/run.go, internal/api/run_leaves.go, internal/api/run_checks.go (the render calls), cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/workflow-invoke.txtar (new). Must not send hand-backs; run-handback does.
fields.statement: Wherever a workflow file accepts prompt today (an agent step, a leaves step's builder and verifier, a checks step's check, critic, fixer and verifier) it also accepts invoke, the exact text the session starts with, and handback, the text a hand-back sends it, with prompt an alias of invoke; both take the placeholders {brief}, {slice} and {handback} (the session's file paths), {change}, {run}, {leaf}, {attempt} and {worktree} beside today's; the daemon renders invoke and the agent's adapter delivers it as the first prompt, and handback is rendered for run-handback to send.

fields.reasoning: Read the question, this change set's slice (run-brief-files, agent-invoke-template, guide-contract) and the code. run-brief-files already describes handback.md's content (the cause from rhiza ship check --json), so the format belongs here and the sibling only triggers; one writer avoids two formats. brief.md's sections follow the run-brief-files statement and its acceptance (TestBriefFiles names change set, intent, leaves with acceptance, decisions, constraints, prePushCheck, contract section), kept deterministic per the same-model-same-output constraint. internal/run/store.go keeps journals at <commondir>/rhiza/runs/<id>.jsonl and its listing skips directories, so <id>/ beside it is safe; TmpDir is removed at run end, so it cannot hold files a hand-back or later attempt reads, and per-session subfolders avoid clashes between parallel builder sessions of one leaves step. internal/workflow/workflow.go has prompt on agent steps, Role (builder, verifier, critic, fixer) and fileCheck, so invoke as prompt's alias must apply in each of those places.
fields.statement: handback.md: this change set owns the file's path, format and writer (run-brief-files ships a function that writes handback.md from a hand-back cause of any failing step: the step and outcome, a gate step's failing commands with their kept output, rhiza ship check --json's failed CI runs with their saved logs, or conflicted files; tested directly); the sibling's run-handback leaf owns triggering a hand-back and calls that writer, writing no handback.md format of its own. brief.md: deterministic Markdown, same bytes for the same model and run, with sections in this order: the change set (title, ID, intent); the leaves (handle, statement, acceptance each); decisions (statement each); constraints (statement each); check commands (rhiza.ship.prePushCheck and rhiza.ship.localGate when set, else none); the contract (a short summary of the obligations ending 'Full contract: rhiza guide contract'). Location: a durable per-run directory beside the journal, <commondir>/rhiza/runs/<run id>/, with one subdirectory per session named from its step plus, where present, its role or check, leaf and attempt (e.g. build/builder-<leaf>-1); it holds that session's brief.md, slice.json and handback.md, is kept when the run ends (unlike the run's temp folder) and is not inside any worktree. invoke and handback keys: accepted everywhere prompt is accepted today: an agent step, a leaves step's builder and verifier, a checks step's each check, critic, fixer and verifier; prompt stays an alias of invoke there, and setting both prompt and invoke on one table is refused by rhiza workflow check.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestSessionBrief shows an agent step's, a builder's and a checks step's verifier's session getting their own directory with brief.md and slice.json, slice.json equal to rhiza slice --json for the change set, the three variables set only when their file exists, and a session started outside a run getting none; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/brief-files passes with a fake agent printing its RHIZA_BRIEF file, and its failure case: an unwritable runs directory fails the session start with a message naming the path and starts no agent. Touches: internal/api/run_brief.go (new), internal/api/run_brief_test.go (new), internal/api/run.go (StartAgent), internal/api/run_leaves.go, internal/api/run_checks.go, internal/api/session_run.go (launchEnv), cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/brief-files.txtar (new). Must not change prompt rendering or the workflow file format.
fields.statement: Before every agent session it starts for a run from a workflow step's table (an agent step, a leaves step's builder and verifier, a checks step's check, critic, fixer and verifier), the daemon fills the session's directory with brief.md built from the model and slice.json equal to rhiza slice --json for the change set at that moment, and sets RHIZA_BRIEF and RHIZA_SLICE (and RHIZA_HANDBACK when handback.md exists there) in the session's environment; a session outside a run gets none of them.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestArbiterBrief|TestAdvisorBrief' shows an arbiter session and an advisor session each getting its own directory named as stated, holding brief.md and slice.json equal to rhiza slice --json for the run's change set, RHIZA_BRIEF and RHIZA_SLICE set to those files, and their prompts unchanged; failure case: an unwritable runs directory fails the arbiter's start with a message naming the path and starts no session. Touches: internal/api/run.go (StartArbiter, StartAdvisor), internal/api/run_brief.go, internal/api/arbiter_test.go. Must not change the arbiter or advisor prompt or what an arbiter writes.
fields.statement: The arbiter and advisor sessions a run starts get their context in files as every other run session does: before starting one, the daemon fills its own directory, <commondir>/rhiza/runs/<run id>/<arbiter step>/arbiter-<question id>/ for an arbiter and <commondir>/rhiza/runs/<run id>/advisor/advisor-<asking session id>/ for an advisor, with brief.md and slice.json for the run's change set and sets RHIZA_BRIEF and RHIZA_SLICE in its environment; their prompts are unchanged.
